ValidationRule.description: Requires the picklist field for Standard Setup under certain conditions: Primary Service Line: DB&R, One Time Shred, RM, Shred, RM Pathology, Vault Climate Control Second Service Line: RM, Shred, One Time Shred Deal Type: New Deal, New Service Line
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(NCSP_Service_Line__c,'DB&R'), ISPICKVAL(NCSP_Service_Line__c,'RM'), ISPICKVAL(Second_Service_Line__c,'RM'), ISPICKVAL(NCSP_Service_Line__c,'Shred'), ISPICKVAL(Second_Service_Line__c,'Shred'), ISPICKVAL(NCSP_Service_Line__c,'One Time Shred'), ISPICKVAL(Second_Service_Line__c,'One Time Shred'), ISPICKVAL(NCSP_Service_Line__c,'RM Pathology'), ISPICKVAL(NCSP_Service_Line__c,'Vault Climate Control')), ISBLANK(TEXT(Non_Standard_Setup__c)), (ISPICKVAL( Deal_Type__c , "New Deal") || ISPICKVAL(Deal_Type__c, "New Service Line")), (ISCHANGED(NCSP_Service_Line__c) || ISCHANGED(Second_Service_Line__c) || ISCHANGED(Deal_Type__c) || ISCHANGED(Non_Standard_Setup__c))
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please identify if booking requires a Standard Setup.
